description:
The star names this API accepts, from our fixed-star catalogue (953 stars): traditional name, Bayer nomenclature, constellation and magnitude, with the 36-star astrological default set flagged. Optional `?maxMagnitude=` trims to the bright end. Static lookup, no chart needed.

[Group: Aspects & Points]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/fixed-stars/catalog]
[Cost: 5 credits (Tier ½)]
name: astroway_aspects_fixed_stars_catalog
title: Fixed star catalogue
